cause_quote: The introducing diff added `persistPending([...previousById.values()])` to the plugin convergence callback, opening a shared-state write transaction before Doctor reached schema repair.
user_saw: When upgrading from an affected July release, operators saw Doctor stop with an `audit-events-v2` schema error.
summary: Doctor now repairs the shared SQLite schema before recording deferred plugin migrations.
reasoning: I checked #147711 and its parent. The parent already ran schema repair in `autoMigrateLegacyState`, and #147711 introduced deferred-plugin persistence ahead of that step, so the ordering defect shipped with the new deferral path. The fix bundle documents reproduction on both published July releases and a fixture test that verifies the repaired schema, preserved audit record, and pending plugin inputs.
